user.title: Your solar system
user.description: How much the system cost and when it started producing. Use the amount you actually paid, after any tax deduction or subsidy.

data_description.start_date: The day the system started, for example the first day you sold electricity.

source.title: Bought and sold electricity
source.description: Tibber statistics were found. Use them, or pick your own statistics.

custom.title: Bought and sold electricity
custom.description: Pick long-term statistics (energy in kWh, money in your currency). Only bought energy is required. Without the cost of bought energy you need an electricity price sensor.

data_description.import_cost: For example the cost sensor the Energy dashboard creates, or your supplier's statistics.
data_description.export_revenue: If missing, sold energy is valued at the electricity price.
data_description.price: For example Nord Pool. Used when the cost is missing for an hour.

consumption.title: The house's consumption
consumption.description: Pick the statistic for everything the house uses (kWh), usually from your inverter. The README explains how to find or create it for different brands.

fees.title: Grid fees and settings
fees.description: Amounts per kWh in your currency. Look at your grid company's invoice.

data.forecast_days: Forecast based on the last days
data.rewards_include_vat: Monthly rewards are entered including VAT

data_description.grid_fee_import: Transfer fee plus energy tax, including VAT. What you avoid paying for every kWh you don't buy.
data_description.grid_fee_export: What the grid company pays you per sold kWh, if anything.
data_description.supplier_markup: Only used when the hourly cost is missing and the spot price is used instead.
data_description.reward_label: For example Grid Rewards. Shown on the card.
data_description.rewards_include_vat: Off: amounts are entered excluding VAT, and the VAT they save is added.

error.start_in_future: The start date can't be in the future.
error.need_price: Pick either the cost of bought energy or an electricity price sensor.
error.need_export_value: Pick either the revenue for sold energy or an electricity price sensor.

data.forecast_days: Forecast based on the last days
data.rewards_include_vat: Monthly rewards are entered including VAT

pick_entry.message: There are several Solar Payback entries, pick one.

set_monthly_reward.name: Set monthly reward
set_monthly_reward.description: Enters a month's reward, for example Tibber Grid Rewards from the invoice or the app.

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if you have more than one.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: The reward for the month, as a positive number.

includes_vat.name: Includes VAT
includes_vat.description: Leave empty to use the setting of the entry.

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if you have more than one.
